image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a tabby cat sleeping curled up. The cat's head is tucked in, eyes closed, with visible whiskers and a pink nose. The fur shows distinct brown and black tabby striping (mackerel pattern). A portion of the striped tail is visible on the right side. The background appears to be a textured beige carpet or fabric.
